question: India’s first transgender clinic reopens in _____________ with aid from Tata Trusts.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Hyderabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India’s first transgender clinic reopens in Hyderabad with aid from Tata Trusts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**India’s first transgender clinic**, the **Mitr Clinic**, now **Sabrang** has been **reopened in Hyderabad** with support from **Tata Trusts**.

 
 
• 
 
Originally **launched in 2021**, it is the **first clinic entirely run and staffed by transgender individuals** in India.

 
 
• 
 
The clinic provides **inclusive, dignified, and community-led healthcare** for the transgender community.

 
 
• 
 
**Services offered include**:

 
 
• 
 
**General health services**

 
 
• 
 
**Counselling and clinical consultations** on:

 
 
• 
 
**Hormone Replacement Therapy (HRT)**

 
 
• 
 
**Breast augmentation**

 
 
• 
 
**Gender affirmation procedures**

 
 
• 
 
**Mental health support**

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Treatment for HIV/STIs**

 
 
• 
 
**Psychological support**
